integrity: A complete constructive all-length proof and reproducible finite consistency checks are supplied. No independent external audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet, Hamming weight exactly two, cyclic symbol-pair distance at least four, and lengths at least three only.
Does not classify all extremal codebooks or extend to other Hamming weights or distances.
A closely related 2025 constant-pair-weight study was accessible through its abstract and public preview but not in full text; prior exact mixed-layer coverage remains a residual bibliographic risk.
Reproducibility program checks finite cases; the all-length assertion follows from the mathematical proof.
title: Exact capacity of constant-weight-two binary symbol-pair codes at distance four
